title: cladium iridifolium
intro: Cladium iridifolium, commonly known as yellow-eyed grass, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of Cladium iridifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the plant's properties and potential applications.
